description: DEA controlled substance schedules (21 CFR 1308.11-1308.15, via eCFR): substance name and DEA Controlled Substances Code Number for schedule I to V table entries matching a name. Substances listed only in paragraphs are not searched. Does not include registration status. Up to 20 matches per call. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
